D0_vanilla.technique: Textbook DeepONet: branch on the raw contract parameters plus a put flag, trunk on (S_i/K, v0_i, tau); simulated price labels; Adam

D1_reduced.technique: Exact reduction: branch on the Heston parameters and both correlations, trunk on (z, s, v, tau); put-call parity

D2_hard_payoff.technique: Hard terminal condition: c = Levy + tau * <branch, trunk(z, s, v, sqrt(tau))>

D3_differential.technique: Differential (Sobolev) training: add the simulated first and second derivatives of the call in the log forwards (analytic per path)

D4_physics.technique: Physics-informed DeepONet: add the PDE residual on unlabelled collocation over the whole computational domain (tau from 0), the far z boundary and the variance boundary of P4, with sqrt(v + 0.01) in the trunk

D5_similarity.technique: Boundary-layer coordinate in the trunk: tanh(z / (3 sigma_ref sqrt(tau))) with sigma_ref = 0.3, so the trunk still sees coordinates only

D6_lbfgs.technique: Quasi-Newton polish: full-batch L-BFGS warm-started from D5 on 4,096 labelled contracts and 4,096 collocation points

D8_envelope.technique: Enveloped correction: c = Levy + tau * phi(d_2) * <branch, trunk>, trained from a fresh start through the Adam and L-BFGS stages

D9_ensemble.technique: Ensemble: average of four independently seeded D8 trainings (seeds 0-3); Greeks are member averages

D10_permutation.technique: Stock-permutation augmentation: every labelled draw (price and derivative labels) is presented under a random relabelling of the stocks, under which the price is unchanged; otherwise as D8, from a fresh start, one seed
